q: Is medical screening in India of international standard?
a: Our partner hospitals hold JCI and NABH accreditation, the same international and national standards used to audit leading hospitals worldwide. Imaging is reported by senior radiologists and your report is written in English.

q: What exactly does the price include?
a: Screening, treatments, accommodation, meals, all domestic flights, ferries and private transfers, visa assistance and your coordinator. International flights and personal expenses are not included.

q: Do I need a medical visa?
a: Most guests travel on India's e-Medical visa. We guide the application and issue the hospital invitation letter within 48 hours of confirming your plan.
Yes. Companions can join any leg, with or without their own screening. Your advisor will quote a shared plan.

q: What if my screening finds something?
a: Your physician explains every finding in person. If follow-up is advisable, we arrange it in India or share your records with your doctor at home, whichever you prefer.

q: When is the best time to travel?
a: October to April suits all three legs. Kerala's monsoon (June to September) is traditionally prized for Ayurveda; Goa and Andaman are best outside it.
